records.body:
**Problem.** `app/x402/middleware.py` (the `USDC_TOKEN_METADATA` table, around lines 57-66 on `dev`) advertises `extra.name = "USDC"`, version "2", for network `base`. The Base mainnet USDC contract's EIP-712 `name()` is `"USD Coin"`. `"USDC"` is correct only on Base Sepolia.

**Impact.** Clients and facilitators build the EIP-3009 signing and verification domain from `extra`. On `X402_NETWORK=base`, signatures made against the advertised domain don't match the on-chain `DOMAIN_SEPARATOR`, so every mainnet payment fails verification. Nothing is lost, because it fails closed, but mainnet payments can't work. Startup validation (#407) doesn't check this value.

**Evidence.** Read-only calls to Base mainnet USDC:
- `name()` returns `"USD Coin"`, `version()` returns `"2"`, and `DOMAIN_SEPARATOR` is `0x02fa72…834f`.
- The separator computed with `"USDC"` on chain 8453 doesn't match it; the one computed with `"USD Coin"` does.

Found by the 2026-09 client audits. The CLI has the same bug on its side (swarm_provenance_CLI audit, CLI-001), and both must be fixed together.

**Fix (minimal).**
- Set `name: "USD Coin"` for `base`.
- Add a test pinning both networks' domain separators to the recorded on-chain values.
- Optionally, at startup on mainnet, compare the configured domain against the chain.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] The `base` metadata uses `"USD Coin"`.
- [ ] A test pins the Base and Base Sepolia separators.

Agreed — on Base mainnet the USDC contract (0x8335…2913) answers `name() = "USD Coin"`, `version() = "2"`; "USDC" is Base Sepolia's name (0x036C…CF7e). A cheap guard against it coming back: build the domain separator from your table and compare it with the token's `DOMAIN_SEPARATOR()` in a test, per network. Disclosure: we run an offline checker for exactly this class of failure — give it the X-PAYMENT header (or authorization + signature + network) and it says whether USDC will accept the signature and, if not, which domain it was actually made for. Free via MCP (`x402_check` at https://modelmarket.dev/mcp) or $0.003 via x402 at https://modelmarket.dev/x402/x402-check.
